none: PAS NLM-F6C6E4: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust probably laureate cuirassed right. Reverse description: two Victories facing each other holding wreaths; the wreaths and garlands appear to resemble the letters PR; a feature resembling a cushion crown over these. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN].…
